channel.title: SSbreakingHeadlines
channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Nor'easter brings flooding, outages to NYC, Long Island, New Jersey; one dead
item.description: Tens of millions are in the storm's path, which has canceled flights, concerts and sporting events.

item.title: UK police arrest several under explosives act near US air base
item.description: British police said Sunday morning that several people were arrested on suspicion of offenses under the explosives act near an air base.

item.title: Arrests made, bomb squad sent to air base used by U.S. forces
item.description: The base has hosted U.S. forces involved in targeting Iran since the war began in February.

item.title: Mass shootings in South African townships kill at least 27
item.description: Two separate mass shootings near South Africa's two largest cities left at least 27 people dead.
